verses.en: And he began to speak unto them by parables. A certain man planted a vineyard, and set an hedge about it, and digged a place for the winefat, and built a tower, and let it out to husbandmen, and went into a far country.
verses.pt: Então começou Jesus a falar-lhes por parábolas. Um homem plantou uma vinha, cercou-a com uma sebe, cavou um lagar, e edificou uma torre; depois arrendou-a a uns lavradores e ausentou-se do país.
verses.en_web: He began to speak to them in parables. “A man planted a vineyard, put a hedge around it, dug a pit for the wine press, built a tower, rented it out to a farmer, and went into another country.
verses.en_bbe: And he gave them teaching in the form of stories. A man had a vine-garden planted, and put a wall about it, and made a place for crushing out the wine, and put up a tower, and let it out to field-workers, and went into another country.

verses.en: And at the season he sent to the husbandmen a servant, that he might receive from the husbandmen of the fruit of the vineyard.
verses.pt: No tempo próprio, enviou um servo aos lavradores para que deles recebesse do fruto da vinha.
verses.en_web: When it was time, he sent a servant to the farmer to get from the farmer his share of the fruit of the vineyard.
verses.en_bbe: And when the time came, he sent a servant to get from the workmen some of the fruit of the garden.

verses.en: And they caught him, and beat him, and sent him away empty.
verses.pt: Mas estes, apoderando-se dele, o espancaram e o mandaram embora de mãos vazias.
verses.en_web: They took him, beat him, and sent him away empty.
verses.en_bbe: And they took him, and gave him blows, and sent him away with nothing.

verses.en: And again he sent unto them another servant; and at him they cast stones, and wounded him in the head, and sent him away shamefully handled.
verses.pt: E tornou a enviar-lhes outro servo; e a este feriram na cabeça e o ultrajaram.
verses.en_web: Again, he sent another servant to them; and they threw stones at him, wounded him in the head, and sent him away shamefully treated.
verses.en_bbe: And again he sent to them another servant; and they gave him wounds on the head, and were very cruel to him.

verses.en: And again he sent another; and him they killed, and many others; beating some, and killing some.
verses.pt: Então enviou ainda outro, e a este mataram; e a outros muitos, dos quais a uns espancaram e a outros mataram.
verses.en_web: Again he sent another; and they killed him; and many others, beating some, and killing some.
verses.en_bbe: And he sent another; and they put him to death: and a number of others, whipping some, and putting some to death.

verses.en: Having yet therefore one son, his wellbeloved, he sent him also last unto them, saying, They will reverence my son.
verses.pt: Ora, tinha ele ainda um, o seu filho amado; a este lhes enviou por último, dizendo: A meu filho terão respeito.
verses.en_web: Therefore still having one, his beloved son, he sent him last to them, saying, ‘They will respect my son.’
verses.en_bbe: He still had one, a dearly loved son: he sent him last to them, saying, They will have respect for my son.

verses.en: But those husbandmen said among themselves, This is the heir; come, let us kill him, and the inheritance shall be ours.
verses.pt: Mas aqueles lavradores disseram entre si: Este é o herdeiro; vinde, matemo-lo, e a herança será nossa.
verses.en_web: But those farmers said among themselves, ‘This is the heir. Come, let’s kill him, and the inheritance will be ours.’
verses.en_bbe: But those workmen said among themselves, This is he who will one day be the owner of the property; come, let us put him to death, and the heritage will be ours.

verses.en: And they took him, and killed him, and cast him out of the vineyard.
verses.pt: E, agarrando-o, o mataram, e o lançaram fora da vinha.
verses.en_web: They took him, killed him, and cast him out of the vineyard.
verses.en_bbe: And they took him and put him to death, pushing his body out of the garden.

verses.en: What shall therefore the lord of the vineyard do? he will come and destroy the husbandmen, and will give the vineyard unto others.
verses.pt: Que fará, pois, o senhor da vinha? Virá e destruirá os lavradores, e dará a vinha a outros.
verses.en_web: What therefore will the lord of the vineyard do? He will come and destroy the farmers, and will give the vineyard to others.
verses.en_bbe: What then will the master of the garden do? He will come and put the workmen to death, and will give the garden into the hands of others.

verses.en: And have ye not read this scripture; The stone which the builders rejected is become the head of the corner:
verses.pt: Nunca lestes esta escritura: A pedra que os edificadores rejeitaram, essa foi posta como pedra angular;
verses.en_web: Haven’t you even read this Scripture: ‘The stone which the builders rejected, the same was made the head of the corner.
verses.en_bbe: Have you not seen this which is in the Writings: The stone which the builders put on one side, the same was made the chief stone of the building:

verses.en: This was the Lord’s doing, and it is marvellous in our eyes?
verses.pt: pelo Senhor foi feito isso, e é maravilhoso aos nossos olhos?
verses.en_web: This was from the Lord, it is marvelous in our eyes’?”
verses.en_bbe: This was the Lord's doing, and it is a wonder in our eyes?

verses.en: And they sought to lay hold on him, but feared the people: for they knew that he had spoken the parable against them: and they left him, and went their way.
verses.pt: Procuravam então prendê-lo, mas temeram a multidão, pois perceberam que contra eles proferira essa parábola; e, deixando-o, se retiraram.
verses.en_web: They tried to seize him, but they feared the multitude; for they perceived that he spoke the parable against them. They left him, and went away.
verses.en_bbe: And they made attempts to take him; but they were in fear of the people, because they saw that the story was against them; and they went away from him.

verses.en: And they send unto him certain of the Pharisees and of the Herodians, to catch him in his words.
verses.pt: Enviaram-lhe então alguns dos fariseus e dos herodianos, para que o apanhassem em alguma palavra.
verses.en_web: They sent some of the Pharisees and the Herodians to him, that they might trap him with words.
verses.en_bbe: Then they sent to him certain of the Pharisees and the Herodians, so that they might make use of his words to take him by a trick.

verses.en: And when they were come, they say unto him, Master, we know that thou art true, and carest for no man: for thou regardest not the person of men, but teachest the way of God in truth: Is it lawful to give tribute to Caesar, or not?
verses.pt: Aproximando-se, pois, disseram-lhe: Mestre, sabemos que és verdadeiro, e de ninguém se te dá; porque não olhas à aparência dos homens, mas ensinas segundo a verdade o caminho de Deus; é lícito dar tributo a César, ou não? Daremos, ou não daremos?
verses.en_web: When they had come, they asked him, “Teacher, we know that you are honest, and don’t defer to anyone; for you aren’t partial to anyone, but truly teach the way of God. Is it lawful to pay taxes to Caesar, or not?
verses.en_bbe: And when they had come, they said to him, Master, we are certain that you are true, and have no fear of anyone: you have no respect for a man's position, but you are teaching the true way of God: Is it right to give taxes to Caesar or not?

verses.en: Shall we give, or shall we not give? But he, knowing their hypocrisy, said unto them, Why tempt ye me? bring me a penny, that I may seeit.
verses.pt: Mas Jesus, percebendo a hipocrisia deles, respondeu-lhes: Por que me experimentais? trazei-me um denário para que eu o veja.
verses.en_web: Shall we give, or shall we not give?” But he, knowing their hypocrisy, said to them, “Why do you test me? Bring me a denarius, that I may see it.”
verses.en_bbe: Are we to give or not to give? But he, conscious of their false hearts, said to them, Why do you put me to the test? give me a penny, so that I may see it.

verses.en: And they brought it. And he saith unto them, Whose is this image and superscription? And they said unto him, Caesar’s.
verses.pt: E eles lho trouxeram. Perguntou-lhes Jesus: De quem é esta imagem e inscrição? Responderam-lhe: De César.
verses.en_web: They brought it. He said to them, “Whose is this image and inscription?” They said to him, “Caesar’s.”
verses.en_bbe: And they gave him one. And he said to them, Whose is this image and name on it? And they said to him, Caesar's.

verses.en: And Jesus answering said unto them, Render to Caesar the things that are Caesar’s, and to God the things that are God’s. And they marvelled at him.
verses.pt: Disse-lhes Jesus: Dai, pois, a César o que é de César, e a Deus o que é de Deus. E admiravam-se dele.
verses.en_web: Jesus answered them, “Render to Caesar the things that are Caesar’s, and to God the things that are God’s.” They marveled greatly at him.
verses.en_bbe: And Jesus said to them, Give to Caesar the things which are Caesar's, and to God the things which are God's. And they were full of wonder at him.

verses.en: Then come unto him the Sadducees, which say there is no resurrection; and they asked him, saying,
verses.pt: Então se aproximaram dele alguns dos saduceus, que dizem não haver ressurreição, e lhe perguntaram, dizendo:
verses.en_web: There came to him Sadducees, who say that there is no resurrection. They asked him, saying,
verses.en_bbe: And there came to him Sadducees, who say there is no coming back from the dead; and they put a question to him, saying,

verses.en: Master, Moses wrote unto us, If a man’s brother die, and leave his wife behind him, and leave no children, that his brother should take his wife, and raise up seed unto his brother.
verses.pt: Mestre, Moisés nos deixou escrito que se morrer alguém, deixando mulher sem deixar filhos, o irmão dele case com a mulher, e suscite descendência ao irmão.
verses.en_web: “Teacher, Moses wrote to us, ‘If a man’s brother dies, and leaves a wife behind him, and leaves no children, that his brother should take his wife, and raise up offspring for his brother.’
verses.en_bbe: Master, in the law Moses says, If a man's brother comes to his end, and has a wife still living and no child, it is right for his brother to take his wife, and get a family for his brother.

verses.en: Now there were seven brethren: and the first took a wife, and dying left no seed.
verses.pt: Ora, havia sete irmãos; o primeiro casou-se e morreu sem deixar descendência;
verses.en_web: There were seven brothers. The first took a wife, and dying left no offspring.
verses.en_bbe: There were seven brothers: and the first took a wife, and at his death there were no offspring;

verses.en: And the second took her, and died, neither left he any seed: and the third likewise.
verses.pt: o segundo casou-se com a viúva, e morreu, não deixando descendência; e da mesma forma, o terceiro; e assim os sete, e não deixaram descendência.
verses.en_web: The second took her, and died, leaving no children behind him. The third likewise;
verses.en_bbe: And the second took her, and at his death there were no offspring; and the third the same:

verses.en: And the seven had her, and left no seed: last of all the woman died also.
verses.pt: Depois de todos, morreu também a mulher.
verses.en_web: and the seven took her and left no children. Last of all the woman also died.
verses.en_bbe: And all the seven had no seed. Last of all the woman herself came to her death.

verses.en: In the resurrection therefore, when they shall rise, whose wife shall she be of them? for the seven had her to wife.
verses.pt: Na ressurreição, de qual deles será ela esposa, pois os sete por esposa a tiveram?
verses.en_web: In the resurrection, when they rise, whose wife will she be of them? For the seven had her as a wife.”
verses.en_bbe: In the future life, when they come back from the dead, whose wife will she be? for the seven had her for a wife.

verses.en: And Jesus answering said unto them, Do ye not therefore err, because ye know not the scriptures, neither the power of God?
verses.pt: Respondeu-lhes Jesus: Porventura não errais vós em razão de não compreenderdes as Escrituras nem o poder de Deus?
verses.en_web: Jesus answered them, “Isn’t this because you are mistaken, not knowing the Scriptures, nor the power of God?
verses.en_bbe: Jesus said to them, Is not this the reason for your error, that you have no knowledge of the holy Writings or of the power of God?

verses.en: For when they shall rise from the dead, they neither marry, nor are given in marriage; but are as the angels which are in heaven.
verses.pt: Porquanto, ao ressuscitarem dos mortos, nem se casam, nem se dão em casamento; pelo contrário, são como os anjos nos céus.
verses.en_web: For when they will rise from the dead, they neither marry, nor are given in marriage, but are like angels in heaven.
verses.en_bbe: When they come back from the dead, they do not get married, but are like the angels in heaven.

verses.en: And as touching the dead, that they rise: have ye not read in the book of Moses, how in the bush God spake unto him, saying, I am the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob?
verses.pt: Quanto aos mortos, porém, serem ressuscitados, não lestes no livro de Moisés, onde se fala da sarça, como Deus lhe disse: Eu sou o Deus de Abraão, o Deus de Isaque e o Deus de Jacó?
verses.en_web: But about the dead, that they are raised; haven’t you read in the book of Moses, about the Bush, how God spoke to him, saying, ‘I am the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob’?
verses.en_bbe: But as to the dead coming back to life; have you not seen in the book of Moses, about the burning thorn-tree, how God said to him, I am the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob?

verses.en: He is not the God of the dead, but the God of the living: ye therefore do greatly err.
verses.pt: Ora, ele não é Deus de mortos, mas de vivos. Estais em grande erro.
verses.en_web: He is not the God of the dead, but of the living. You are therefore badly mistaken.”
verses.en_bbe: He is not the God of the dead, but of the living: you are greatly in error.

verses.en: And one of the scribes came, and having heard them reasoning together, and perceiving that he had answered them well, asked him, Which is the first commandment of all?
verses.pt: Aproximou-se dele um dos escribas que os ouvira discutir e, percebendo que lhes havia respondido bem, perguntou-lhe: Qual é o primeiro de todos os mandamentos?
verses.en_web: One of the scribes came, and heard them questioning together. Knowing that he had answered them well, asked him, “Which commandment is the greatest of all?”
verses.en_bbe: And one of the scribes came, and hearing their argument together, and seeing that he had given them a good answer, put the question to him, Which law is the first of all?

verses.en: And Jesus answered him, The first of all the commandments is, Hear, O Israel; The Lord our God is one Lord:
verses.pt: Respondeu Jesus: O primeiro é: Ouve, Israel, o Senhor nosso Deus é o único Senhor.
verses.en_web: Jesus answered, “The greatest is, ‘Hear, Israel, the Lord our God, the Lord is one:
verses.en_bbe: Jesus said in answer, The first is, Give ear, O Israel: The Lord our God is one Lord;

verses.en: And thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy mind, and with all thy strength: this is the first commandment.
verses.pt: Amarás, pois, ao Senhor teu Deus de todo o teu coração, de toda a tua alma, de todo o teu entendimento e de todas as tuas forças.
verses.en_web: you shall love the Lord your God with all your heart, and with all your soul, and with all your mind, and with all your strength.’ This is the first commandment.
verses.en_bbe: And you are to have love for the Lord your God with all your heart, and with all your soul, and with all your mind, and with all your strength.

verses.en: And the second is like, namely this, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself. There is none other commandment greater than these.
verses.pt: E o segundo é este: Amarás ao teu próximo como a ti mesmo. Não há outro mandamento maior do que esses.
verses.en_web: The second is like this, ‘You shall love your neighbor as yourself.’ There is no other commandment greater than these.”
verses.en_bbe: The second is this, Have love for your neighbour as for yourself. There is no other law greater than these.

verses.en: And the scribe said unto him, Well, Master, thou hast said the truth: for there is one God; and there is none other but he:
verses.pt: Ao que lhe disse o escriba: Muito bem, Mestre; com verdade disseste que ele é um, e fora dele não há outro;
verses.en_web: The scribe said to him, “Truly, teacher, you have said well that he is one, and there is none other but he,
verses.en_bbe: And the scribe said to him, Truly, Master, you have well said that he is one, and there is no other but he:

verses.en: And to love him with all the heart, and with all the understanding, and with all the soul, and with all the strength, and to love his neighbour as himself, is more than all whole burnt offerings and sacrifices.
verses.pt: e que amá-lo de todo o coração, de todo o entendimento e de todas as forças, e amar o próximo como a si mesmo, é mais do que todos os holocaustos e sacrifícios.
verses.en_web: and to love him with all the heart, and with all the understanding, with all the soul, and with all the strength, and to love his neighbor as himself, is more important than all whole burnt offerings and sacrifices.”
verses.en_bbe: And to have love for him with all the heart, and with all the mind, and with all the strength, and to have the same love for his neighbour as for himself, is much more than all forms of offerings.

verses.en: And when Jesus saw that he answered discreetly, he said unto him, Thou art not far from the kingdom of God. And no man after that durst ask him any question.
verses.pt: E Jesus, vendo que havia respondido sabiamente, disse-lhe: Não estás longe do reino de Deus. E ninguém ousava mais interrogá-lo.
verses.en_web: When Jesus saw that he answered wisely, he said to him, “You are not far from God’s Kingdom.” No one dared ask him any question after that.
verses.en_bbe: And when Jesus saw that he gave a wise answer, he said to him, You are not far from the kingdom of God. And every man after that was in fear of questioning him any more.

verses.en: And Jesus answered and said, while he taught in the temple, How say the scribes that Christ is the Son of David?
verses.pt: Por sua vez, Jesus, enquanto ensinava no templo, perguntou: Como é que os escribas dizem que o Cristo é filho de Davi?
verses.en_web: Jesus responded, as he taught in the temple, “How is it that the scribes say that the Christ is the son of David?
verses.en_bbe: And Jesus, when he was teaching in the Temple, said, How do the scribes say that the Christ is the Son of David?

verses.en: For David himself said by the Holy Ghost, The Lord said to my Lord, Sit thou on my right hand, till I make thine enemies thy footstool.
verses.pt: O próprio Davi falou, movido pelo Espírito Santo: Disse o Senhor ao meu Senhor: Assenta-te à minha direita, até que eu ponha os teus inimigos debaixo dos teus pés.
verses.en_web: For David himself said in the Holy Spirit, ‘The Lord said to my Lord, “Sit at my right hand, until I make your enemies the footstool of your feet.”’
verses.en_bbe: David himself said in the Holy Spirit, The Lord said to my Lord, Be seated at my right hand, till I put those who are against you under your feet.

verses.en: David therefore himself calleth him Lord; and whence is he then his son? And the common people heard him gladly.
verses.pt: Davi mesmo lhe chama Senhor; como é ele seu filho? E a grande multidão o ouvia com prazer.
verses.en_web: Therefore David himself calls him Lord, so how can he be his son?” The common people heard him gladly.
verses.en_bbe: David himself gives him the name of Lord; and how then is he his son? And the common people gave ear to him gladly.

verses.en: And he said unto them in his doctrine, Beware of the scribes, which love to go in long clothing, and love salutations in the marketplaces,
verses.pt: E prosseguindo ele no seu ensino, disse: Guardai-vos dos escribas, que gostam de andar com vestes compridas, e das saudações nas praças,
verses.en_web: In his teaching he said to them, “Beware of the scribes, who like to walk in long robes, and to get greetings in the marketplaces,
verses.en_bbe: And in his teaching he said, Be on your watch against the scribes, whose pleasure it is to go about in long robes and be respected in the market-places,

verses.en: And the chief seats in the synagogues, and the uppermost rooms at feasts:
verses.pt: e dos primeiros assentos nas sinagogas, e dos primeiros lugares nos banquetes,
verses.en_web: and the best seats in the synagogues, and the best places at feasts:
verses.en_bbe: And to have the chief seats in the Synagogues and the first places at feasts;

verses.en: Which devour widows’ houses, and for a pretence make long prayers: these shall receive greater damnation.
verses.pt: que devoram as casas das viúvas, e por pretexto fazem longas orações; estes hão de receber muito maior condenação.
verses.en_web: those who devour widows’ houses, and for a pretense make long prayers. These will receive greater condemnation.”
verses.en_bbe: Who take away the property of widows, and before the eyes of men make long prayers; these will be judged more hardly.

verses.en: And Jesus sat over against the treasury, and beheld how the people cast money into the treasury: and many that were rich cast in much.
verses.pt: E sentando-se Jesus defronte do cofre das ofertas, observava como a multidão lançava dinheiro no cofre; e muitos ricos deitavam muito.
verses.en_web: Jesus sat down opposite the treasury, and saw how the multitude cast money into the treasury. Many who were rich cast in much.
verses.en_bbe: And he took a seat by the place where the money was kept, and saw how the people put money into the boxes: and a number who had wealth put in much.

verses.en: And there came a certain poor widow, and she threw in two mites, which make a farthing.
verses.pt: Vindo, porém, uma pobre viúva, lançou dois leptos, que valiam um quadrante.
verses.en_web: A poor widow came, and she cast in two small brass coins, which equal a quadrans coin.
verses.en_bbe: And there came a poor widow, and she put in two little bits of money, which make a farthing.

verses.en: And he called unto him his disciples, and saith unto them, Verily I say unto you, That this poor widow hath cast more in, than all they which have cast into the treasury:
verses.pt: E chamando ele os seus discípulos, disse-lhes: Em verdade vos digo que esta pobre viúva deu mais do que todos os que deitavam ofertas no cofre;
verses.en_web: He called his disciples to himself, and said to them, “Most certainly I tell you, this poor widow gave more than all those who are giving into the treasury,
verses.en_bbe: And he made his disciples come to him, and said to them, Truly I say to you, This poor widow has put in more than all those who are putting money into the box:

verses.en: For all they did cast in of their abundance; but she of her want did cast in all that she had, even all her living.
verses.pt: porque todos deram daquilo que lhes sobrava; mas esta, da sua pobreza, deu tudo o que tinha, mesmo todo o seu sustento.
verses.en_web: for they all gave out of their abundance, but she, out of her poverty, gave all that she had to live on.”
verses.en_bbe: Because they all put in something out of what they had no need for; but she out of her need put in all she had, even all her living.
